name: NIGER

flag.title: Flag of Niger
flag.note: Orange, white & green — sun in the centre

lead: Niger is a huge, sunny country in West Africa. Over four-fifths of it is Sahara Desert. The south is green. The Niger River curves past farms, and wild giraffes roam near the capital.
geo: Niger is about as big as France, Germany and Spain together. The Niger River loops through the green southwest and gives the country its name.
The Aïr Mountains rise in the north. The Ténéré in the east is one of Earth's emptiest sand seas. W National Park sits on a river bend shaped like a W.
animals: The West African giraffe is the world's rarest giraffe. Only 50 survived in the 1990s. Now the herd has over 600. They roam freely near villages outside Niamey.
The addax antelope lives in the Aïr Desert on almost no water. It gets moisture from dry grasses. Lions, cheetahs and elephants roam W National Park.
culture: The Hausa are famous traders. Tuareg men wear indigo-blue veils and have crossed the Sahara by camel for centuries. People call them the blue men of the desert.
Each year the Wodaabe nomads hold the Gerewol festival. At this beauty contest, men dress up, paint their faces and dance. Women choose a partner.
history: Agadez was a key stop on trans-Saharan trade routes. They carried gold and ivory north. The Songhai Empire ruled much of Niger in the 15th and 16th centuries.
France colonised Niger in the early 1900s. Independence came in 1960. Niger has uranium, fuel for nuclear power. Yet it is one of the world's poorest nations.
wows: Agadez Mosque's minaret, built in 1515, is the world's tallest mud-brick tower at 27 m.
Half of all Nigeriens are younger than 15.7 years.
A lone Ténéré tree stood 400 km from any other until a truck hit it in 1973.
Niger, Burkina Faso and Benin run W National Park together.
Niger is the 7th largest uranium producer on Earth.
West African giraffes wander through village farmland with no fences.
Niger's desert hides Suchomimus, a dinosaur with a crocodile-like face.

myths.myth: Niger and Nigeria are the same place
myths.fact: They are two countries side by side. Niger is the northern one, and people there say nee-ZHAIR.
Most of it is bare rock and gravel. Sand dunes cover only about a quarter of it.
